name: Dubai
hook: Skyline by night, dunes by day
description: A short, dense trip built to contrast — rooftop dinners above the skyline, a private desert safari at golden hour, and a souk crawl for anyone who still wants to haggle.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~13–14hr direct from the US East Coast
quickFacts.climate: Desert — extremely hot summers, mild winters

topExperiences: A private desert safari at golden hour
Dinner at a rooftop table over the skyline
A dhow cruise along Dubai Creek
